data.title: Entitlement
data.tagline: The specific features and allowances granted to an account by its plan or authorization
data.learningOutcome: Distinguish payment, effective access and remaining allowance using the server result.
data.description: In this drawing-tool example, Free allows three generations while Pro includes HD export. Payment and access activation are separate: the server needs effective entitlements and checks every restricted action. Changing a Free label in the browser does not grant access.

learning.assumes: Know that accounts can have different plans and page actions call a server.
learning.outcome: Distinguish payment, effective access and remaining allowance using the server result.

distinctions.label: Authorization
distinctions.explanation: Authorization decides whether an action is allowed using roles, ownership and entitlements; Entitlement describes granted features and allowances, one input to that decision.

distinctions.label: Authentication
distinctions.explanation: Authentication verifies which account made the request; Entitlement describes the features and allowances granted to it.

explanation.title: Features require an entitlement
explanation.text: HD export is an entitlement an account either has or lacks. Authorization also checks roles and resource ownership; Pro does not grant access to someone else’s private files.

explanation.title: Limits include the requested addition
explanation.text: With four of five seats occupied, one more member fits; at five of five, another must be rejected. The server checks current usage plus the requested addition and updates atomically so concurrent requests cannot claim the same allowance.

explanation.title: Sync changes to the access check
explanation.text: A billing provider can notify the application through a Webhook; the application verifies it and updates access. Notifications can be delayed or repeated, requiring retries and reconciliation. Expiration, refunds and downgrades follow the product’s effective dates and refund policy.

data.boundary: Plans, rollout flags and team roles are different rules. Hiding a button only guides the UI; the server makes the final decision using trusted entitlements and other authorization conditions.

lessonPractice.title: A paid upgrade still cannot export; logs show the server entitlement is Free. What should be checked first?

options.label: Refresh login credentials and inspect the account’s sign-in state
options.feedback: The logs already identify stale entitlements. Renewed identity credentials do not prove that access records were updated.

options.label: Check whether the entitlement notification updated the server record
options.feedback: Payment and effective access are separated by synchronization; inspect that step to explain the Free decision.

options.label: Change the browser plan label to Pro and retry the export
options.feedback: Changing a label does not change the server’s entitlement record.

data.agentPrompt: A paid upgrade still cannot export HD images. Trace the entitlement notification, server record and export endpoint to locate the missing update. Verify pending sync, active access and exhausted allowance after the fix.
